changeSet.author: sampath
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO ddp_instance_group (ddp_instance_id, ddp_group_id) SELECT di.ddp_instance_id, dg.group_id FROM ddp_instance di JOIN ddp_group dg ON dg.name = 'juniper-trcc' WHERE di.instance_name = 'trcc';

INSERT INTO ddp_kit_request_settings ( ddp_instance_id, kit_type_id, kit_return_id, carrier_service_to_id, kit_dimension_id, kit_label_length ) SELECT (SELECT ddp_instance_id FROM ddp_instance WHERE instance_name = 'trcc'), (SELECT kit_type_id FROM kit_type WHERE bsp_material_type = 'saliva' AND bsp_receptacle_type = 'Oragene kit'), (SELECT kit_return_id FROM kit_return_information WHERE return_address_phone = '(651) 602-2045'), (SELECT carrier_service_id FROM carrier_service WHERE carrier='FedEx' AND service = 'FEDEX_2_DAY' AND carrier_service_id NOT IN ( SELECT carrier_service_to_id FROM ddp_kit_request_settings settings LEFT JOIN ddp_instance realm ON realm.ddp_instance_id = settings.ddp_instance_id WHERE realm.instance_name = 'mmrf' )), (SELECT kit_dimension_id FROM kit_dimension WHERE kit_description = 'saliva box'), 14

INSERT INTO ddp_kit_request_settings ( ddp_instance_id, kit_type_id, kit_return_id, carrier_service_to_id, kit_dimension_id ) SELECT (SELECT ddp_instance_id FROM ddp_instance WHERE instance_name = 'trcc'), (SELECT kit_type_id FROM kit_type WHERE kit_type_name = 'BLOOD' and bsp_material_type = 'Whole Blood Streck Cell-Free Preserved' and display_name is null), (SELECT kit_return_id FROM kit_return_information WHERE return_address_phone = '(651) 602-2045'), (SELECT carrier_service_id FROM carrier_service WHERE carrier='FedEx' AND service = 'FEDEX_2_DAY' AND carrier_service_id NOT IN ( SELECT carrier_service_to_id FROM ddp_kit_request_settings settings LEFT JOIN ddp_instance realm ON realm.ddp_instance_id = settings.ddp_instance_id WHERE realm.instance_name = 'mmrf' )), (SELECT kit_dimension_id FROM kit_dimension WHERE kit_description = 'blood box')

INSERT INTO ddp_instance_role (ddp_instance_id, instance_role_id) SELECT di.ddp_instance_id, ir.instance_role_id FROM ddp_instance di JOIN instance_role ir ON ir.name = 'juniper_study' WHERE di.instance_name = 'trcc';

INSERT INTO ddp_instance_role (ddp_instance_id, instance_role_id) SELECT di.ddp_instance_id, ir.instance_role_id FROM ddp_instance di JOIN instance_role ir ON ir.name = 'kit_request_activated' WHERE di.instance_name = 'trcc';
